our_interpretation: The claim predicts substantial consumer affordability or demand barriers and rejects a worldwide stock ratio of six humanoid robots per car in the near future.
Cars means cars in use, following the preceding reference to cars on the road. Both stocks must be measured at the same time.
Anytime soon supplies no fixed calendar deadline. The surrounding 2040 discussion is not automatically substituted for that phrase.
Many does not mean most or all. No numerical consumer threshold is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Over a source-grounded near-term interval, representative evidence shows substantial affordability or demand barriers and worldwide humanoid stocks remain below six per car.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified worldwide ratio reaches six humanoid robots per car within an unambiguously near-term interval. Representative evidence of broadly affordable and desired robots could separately challenge the consumer-barrier component.
